instruction.name: xvpermi.d
instruction.description: Select four double words from `a` using `imm[1:0]`, `imm[3:2]`, `imm[5:4]`, and `imm[7:6]`, and store them in `dst`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvpermi.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvpermi.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvpermi.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvpermi.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvpermi.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvpermi.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvpermi.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvpermi.d $xr7, $xr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvpermi.d $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvpermi.d $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvpermi.d $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvpermi.d $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvpermi.d $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvpermi.d $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvpermi.d $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvpermi.d $xr7, $xr15, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.34 cycles. Measured CPI 0.2925; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 0.25. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
